decisions.reason: The polymer concrete housing got its own page in both years and serves as a base component across the drainage families, so it appears to meet aspirations with no trigger for search.
The floor-level shower system moved up to its own page in 2019 and sits at the centre of the firm's low-profile, accessible strategy, which signals results above aspiration.
The designer product fell from its own page to a mere mention, a possible shortfall, but design lines are central to the firm's positioning and its slack allows it to keep the product for now.
The sloped shower element was only ever mentioned, so its results are uncertain, yet it fits the integrated-system direction and is cheap to carry within the compatible product families.
The backflow cellar drain rose to the home page with a specific launch claim, suggesting strong results and a growing market for flood protection.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral accessory that was only mentioned, but it completes the system offer at little resource cost, so no problemistic search is needed.
